verdict.rationale: Stripe documents Transaction objects as the ledger entries for every money movement in a financial account, and says they can be used to reconcile against your internal systems and to track money movement. That gives a finance lead an API-level ledger to reconcile from, but nothing in the evidence describes reconciling Stripe's ledger against the partner bank's core records. Missing for 10: documented daily ledger-to-bank-core reconciliation, disclosure of how API-reported balances are matched to funds actually held at the sponsor bank, and independent or hands-on confirmation that this reconciliation happens.
